name: 小宝
source: 《八零新婚夜，空间囤货养崽暴富》苏晚女儿

identity.en: A skinny kitten-like three-year-old Chinese toddler girl, early 1980s rural northern China
identity.text: 3 岁瘦得像小猫的北方农村小女孩，1980 年代初

face.en: Petite thin face, large shy dark eyes, small delicate nose, pale cheeks, timid expression
face.text: 小瘦脸，大眼睛怯生生，小鼻子秀气，脸颊苍白，神情怯生

hair.en: Tiny black hair tied into two small tufts on top, each tied with a short red string
hair.text: 黑发扎成头顶两个小揪揪，各系一截短红头绳

top.en: A tiny faded brick-red padded jacket patched at the elbows, too big on her small frame
top.text: 小小的洗旧砖红补丁小棉袄，穿在瘦小身上偏大

bottom.en: Dark grey baggy padded trousers, small worn cloth shoes
bottom.text: 深灰肥大棉裤，旧小布鞋

details.en: Two tiny top tufts tied with short red strings
details.text: 两个系短红头绳的头顶小揪揪

details.en: The too-big collar of the tiny brick-red padded jacket
details.text: 小砖红棉袄偏大的领口

details.en: Sleeves rolled up on the oversized tiny jacket

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
